rationale: Price has completed a dramatic intraday reversal — spiking to $143.00 then collapsing to near the session low — and is now consolidating in a very tight, low-volume band ($133.09–$133.26) with an ATR of only $0.29 on 5-minute bars, suggesting the move has exhausted itself. The 61.6 bps bid-ask spread materially erodes edge on any position, and with price already sitting just ~$1.59 above the day's low, the risk/reward for a short is unfavorable while the structural bearishness (price far below both VWAPs) makes a long unattractive. With no news catalyst confirmed and today's realized P&L already negative, the setup does not offer sufficient asymmetry to commit capital.
